audit-log.title: Audit log
audit-log.description: Who changed what in this workspace, and when, from what to what. Use it to answer "who did this?", to review changes made by your team, and to check what platform support did when you asked for help.

tile.label: Audit log
tile.description: See who changed what in your workspace, when, and from what to what. Filter it and export it.
tile.keywords: activity log, audit, history, changes, who changed, security, compliance, export, support access

retention.days: Entries are kept for {days, plural, one {# day} other {# days}}, then deleted. The platform sets this period.
retention.forever: Entries are kept without an end date. The platform sets this policy.
retention.unknown: Entries are kept for the period the platform sets, then deleted.

forbidden.title: You do not have access to the audit log
forbidden.body: Ask a workspace Owner or Admin to give your role the permission to view the audit log.

filters.label: Audit log filters
filters.searchHint: Matches the area and the action only, never the changed values.

table.caption: Audit entries, newest first. Times are shown in your time zone ({zone}).
table.zone: Times are shown in your time zone: {zone}.

states.emptyHint: Changes your team makes will appear here.
states.emptyFilteredHint: Try a longer period or remove a filter.
states.showing: {count, plural, one {# entry loaded} other {# entries loaded}}

detail.title: Audit entry
detail.noChanges: This entry does not list field changes.
detail.supportTitle: Platform support was acting in your workspace
detail.supportBody: A member of platform support used a support session as {name}. They could do what that person can do.
detail.supportNoReason: The reason for this session is no longer available.
detail.secretHint: Passwords, keys and tokens are never shown.
detail.maskedNote: Personal data such as phone numbers, e-mail addresses, names and notes is partly hidden. Secrets are never shown.
detail.maskedNoteOwner: Secrets such as passwords, keys and tokens are hidden for everyone.
detail.audited: Opening this entry is recorded in the audit log.

export.title: Export
export.note: Prepares a CSV of the entries that match the filters above. It is kept for {days} days and always hides personal data.
export.requested: The export is being prepared. We will email you when it is ready.
export.failed: This export could not be built. Request it again.

errors.network: Could not reach the server. Check your connection and try again.
errors.forbidden: You do not have permission to do this.
errors.notFound: That entry or export was not found.
errors.rangeInvalid: Choose a period of at most 400 days, ending after it starts.
errors.exportInProgress: An export is already being prepared. Wait for its email, then request another.
errors.exportNotReady: This export is not ready, or it has expired.
errors.rateLimited: Too many requests. Wait a moment and try again.
errors.validation: One of the filters is not valid.
